Name: Fast
Description: Fast vis. Good for quick playtests, but r_speeds and visibility quality will be poor.

Name: No Fix Portal File
Description: SDHLT: disables the .prt portal-file optimisation used for direct import into the J.A.C.K. map editor.
Warning: SDHLT-specific parameter, not present in vanilla ZHLT.

Name: Chart
Description: Prints BSP statistics before writing the output.

Name: Texdata
Description: Increases the texture memory pool size, in KB.

Name: Low Priority
Description: Runs HLVIS as a low-priority process.

Name: High Priority
Description: Runs HLVIS as a high-priority process.
Warning: Can freeze your computer while compiling.

Name: Threads
Description: Manually overrides the number of CPU threads used.
